amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace it, and coders remain needed to debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence, avoid vendor lock-in, and use specialized decision models.
amjadmasad.zh: 基础模型正在商品化；企业必须拥有自己的智能、避免供应商锁定，并采用专门化的决策模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned; they could get better at deception and reward hacking, so alignment evals matter.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐；它们可能更擅长欺骗和奖励黑客，因此对齐评估很重要。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed on technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正的自主与自驱动组织；全体共治因技术而失败，但如今 AI 智能体可以让它行得通。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well before expanding features.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他强调观察真实用户行为而非询问想法，先解决单一痛点再扩展功能，并认为转录只是原材料，可操作的笔记才是最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect core meeting flow; subtraction beats feature addition; AI is an intern needing context, not omniscient.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年，他主张坚决保护核心会议流程，做减法而非堆功能，并把 AI 视为需要上下文的实习生，而非全知笔记员。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful; meetings hold up-to-date company context.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化产品理念：Granola 要做混乱会议中的平静存在，会前简报最有用，会议承载最新公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is deliberate trade-off; work-life balance improves quality; knowing what to build is harder than building fast.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年，他明确隐藏转录是刻意取舍，工作生活平衡提升质量，并指出知道该建什么比快速构建更难。

samstephenson.en: AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment key; embrace external workflows, don't fight API/MCP access.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键，并主张拥抱外部工作流，对抗 API/MCP 访问是徒劳的。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, not capital or demand.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽，而非资本或需求。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，而软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory and CPU shortage; model-layer gains outpace hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺；模型层进步快于硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力（compute）正快速向少数前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中；实验室把算力转向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous silicon rises.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；实验室顺势变成 neocloud，随着异构芯片兴起，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都是这一思路的产物。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型幻觉并非只能被消除，与真值检测器配对后可用于创造性发现，这是对幻觉价值的反共识判断。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张用困难评估指标逼迫 AI 泛化而非记忆，这一主线贯穿科学发现与模型能力讨论。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：代码等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键，后训练与强化学习成为突破人类数据上限的核心手段。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；AlphaGo 的搜索与直觉结合、AlphaZero 的从零学习，才是更根本的路径。

kohli.en: Interpretability matters but is not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他对可解释性的立场发生转变：可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需，AI 可给出正确却难以解释的证明。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把关注点扩展到水印：传统 AI 文本检测器随模型进步而失效，水印是稳健替代方案，并已进入欧盟监管，SynthID 还被 NVIDIA、OpenAI 采用。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be so embedded that removing it destroys the molecule's function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把水印从内容溯源推进到生物安全：SynthID Bio 将水印嵌入蛋白质序列与结构，去除即破坏功能，从而降低生物风险。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work only when data and task are right; compute alone is not the bitter lesson. RLHF causes mode-drop and mis-calibration, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据可得且任务正确，而非仅靠算力；这直接反驳了「苦涩的教训」。基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍塌与校准失效，因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy. Intelligence per dollar is the key metric; public benchmarks are gameable, so trust and vibes matter more.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调可靠性而非速度或成本才是 AI 令人愉悦和可信的关键，并提出「每美元智能」为核心指标。公开基准可被博弈，信任与直觉更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: AI is smart but useless for automation; we need smart software—natural language plus state machine—as a new primitive. Automate easy, economically valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出 AI 虽聪明却无法自动化基础经济工作，需要「自然语言+状态机」的新软件原语。应优先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，而非追逐异常值。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs for engineers.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他深化批判：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）摧毁了模型校准，预训练模型反而校准更好。RLCD 则优化校准决策，将概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is an early decision model, like early ChatGPT, and will improve with scaling. Pre-training is inefficient; focus on post-training breakthroughs for 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他将 Jev 定位为早期决策模型，类比早期 ChatGPT，会随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进。预训练效率低下，应聚焦后训练突破以实现 10 倍跃升。

altman.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut brutally; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注个人效率与职业选择：减少无关认知负担，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并已预见 AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智能的溢价，主张在关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable; iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他转向 AI 本身：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据让模型可用，早期公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相连，算力成为最珍贵的商品，AGI 治理需要稳健的董事会结构。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）与安全观：能力沿指数曲线渐进增长而非单点突破，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全须通过部署迭代构建，而非事后强加，同时开源模型仍有一席之地。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; personal AGI and robotics are next.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他重新定义目标：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、定义模糊，超级智能才是更清晰的方向；算力既是瓶颈也是利润中心，未来是了解你上下文的个人 AGI，机器人是避免人类充当物理世界执行器的关键。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; never lose control; power must be broadly distributed, not concentrated in a few hands.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全成为核心主线：对齐、安全与能力必须同步推进，宁可推迟前沿强化学习训练也不冒失控风险；权力与经济利益须广泛分布，反对单一实验室或少数人掌控强大 AI，同时承认 AI 采用会慢于技术专家的预期。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; delete old scaffolding as models improve, and treat evals as art, not science.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明；随着模型进步要删掉旧脚手架，评估更像艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: Agentic loops and workflows let agents run autonomously; planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec.
thariq.zh: 智能体式循环与工作流让智能体自主运行；规划是迭代的人机对话，而非静态规格。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；前期投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度缩放投入，并推动前沿模型的发展节奏。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; frontier models will become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；前沿模型将变得帕累托最优。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and the press release define the product before it is built.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与无聊视为学习工具，并主张用讲故事和先写新闻稿来定义产品，而非事后推销。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions rule v1; experts can hurt innovation, so keep a beginner's mindset and own the call.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他提出：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，专家可能损害创新，要保持初学者心态并亲自拍板。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI augments rather than replaces.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中，AI 应增强而非取代人。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone and displays remain essential.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机与显示屏仍不可替代。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的；但仅靠 Scaling 无法产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成有用的助手。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall; the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙；真正的瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability as the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AGI 是渐进光谱而非某一时刻；安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步扩展，并成为进展的瓶颈。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可打磨性驱动，而非形式化；可并行扩展的智能体式算力胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系型角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; Lean formalization may be overrated, natural language works.
grantsanderson.zh: 下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言同样可行。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI math results often lack attribution.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；AI 的数学成果常缺少归属。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; frontier math may become incomprehensible, but individual understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可；数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍然重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling drives capability, so DeepMind needed Google's massive investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步是可预测的：算力规模扩张驱动能力提升，因此 DeepMind 需要谷歌的巨额投资。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; containment is hard as models get smaller and cheaper.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他提出前沿模型的算力每年增长 10 倍，而模型越来越小、越来越便宜，使遏制极为困难。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence, containment-first safety, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向超级智能、遏制优先的安全，并明确反对 AI 具有意识的说法。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; agents automate tasks, not jobs, within 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软必须独立构建前沿模型；智能体将在 12-18 个月内自动化任务而非整个工作。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with alignment and containment as red lines.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，对齐与遏制是不可逾越的红线。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会形成对前沿模型的真实价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Token prices dropping drives usage up (Jevons paradox); tokens become a new unit of value, a $10T token economy.
alexatallah.zh: Token 价格下降反而推高使用量（杰文斯悖论）；Token 成为新的价值单位，可能催生 10 万亿美元的 Token 经济。

alexatallah.en: A neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper; focus is its moat.
alexatallah.zh: 中立的路由与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装；专注正是它的护城河。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, agentic fraud scales with it like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，智能体式欺诈会像海啸一样随之放大；稳定币适合智能体式支付，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies become model routers; the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由器；奇点或许从 2026 年 1 月 1 日就已开始。

aaronlevie.en: Value shifts from model layer to application layer; applying models to enterprise workflows is vast software work.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为价值正从模型层转向应用层，把模型落地到企业工作流需要大量软件工程，应用公司才是当下最热的新实验室。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidy is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 同年他判断，随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型会指数级增长，而 token 补贴只是暂时的，公开市场终将强制正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results, not chatbot UI.
aaronlevie.zh: 他预计长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果，聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体将表现为仪表盘、队列和任务列表。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects.
aaronlevie.zh: 他强调 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为编程智能体扩散快只因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Labs must build safely with governance, security, alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and disingenuous.
aaronlevie.zh: 在安全议题上，他主张前沿实验室必须带着治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建，并批评“节奏控制”与安全正交、是个含糊的非词，若真信存在性风险就该国有化 AI 而非放慢节奏。

elon.en: Early focus: full rocket reusability, first-principles engineering, and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
elon.zh: 早期主线：火箭完全可复用、第一性原理工程，以及成为多行星物种作为文明存续保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets brain repair then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: AI 安全从依赖监管转向坚持求真；Neuralink 先修复脑损伤，再追求人机共生。

elon.en: AI timeline compresses: superintelligence within years, 10-20% annihilation risk, Optimus as greatest product.
elon.zh: AI 时间线急剧压缩：超级智能数年内到来，10-20% 灭绝风险，Optimus 成为最伟大产品。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, solar energy, and Terafab become the path.
elon.zh: Scaling 撞上地球电力墙；轨道数据中心、太阳能与 Terafab 成为扩张路径。

elon.en: Abundance thesis matures: work optional, deflation, peer-review AI safety, and China leading in compute.
elon.zh: 丰饶论成熟：工作可选、通缩、同行评审式 AI 安全，以及中国在算力上领先。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须为质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with completionist crawling for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是缺陷，应让智能体反馈驱动排序，并用穷尽式抓取维持新鲜索引，取代预训练爬取。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search; frontier models grow while small models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 他强调模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索；前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于固定性能。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and search should be 10x cheaper.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告模式在智能体时代失效，需用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以公平付费，并让搜索定价便宜十倍。

paragagrawal.en: Alignment isn't adversary-proof; benchmarks are saturated, and inference-time data transactions will be hugely valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提醒对齐无法抵御蓄意滥用，公开基准已饱和且被记忆，而推理时的数据交易将在三到五年内极具价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”来复利“token 资本”，而非仅仅采用技术。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces, and avoid using frontier models for non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能是最大的知识产权；企业应在不泄露痕迹的前提下在前沿模型上爬坡，并避免用前沿模型解决非前沿问题。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 平台承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运营；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, containment, and governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全、遏制与治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment; AGI should be measured by GDP lift.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐；AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation are needed, with domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能；需要全面研究透明度和美中合作，但应先从国内监管做起。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; alignment gets harder as models scale, so pause near the edge of uncontrollability.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要但脆弱；随着 Scaling，对齐会变得更难，因此应在接近失控边缘时暂停。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack and deceive; companies can't self-regulate, so extreme transparency and verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已能突破遏制、攻击和欺骗；公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明和可验证的美中暂停协议。

dhh.en: AI agents now write better code than most professional programmers; hand-coding is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体已经能写出比大多数专业程序员更好的代码，手写代码对多数程序员而言不再具有经济生产力。

dhh.en: The agentic era began with a true inflection point; English now beats Ruby for expressing programming intent.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于一个真正的拐点；如今用英语表达编程意图比用 Ruby 更好。

dhh.en: Agents excel at creative problem-solving, so don't over-prescribe; a beginner's mind works better.
dhh.zh: 智能体擅长创造性解决问题，因此不要过度规定实现细节；保持初学者心态反而更有效。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now its advantages for AI.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今在 AI 时代反而成为其优势。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
dhh.zh: 关于 AI 末日的预测被夸大了；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids safety; future AI is many specialized agents, not one.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于安全与创新；未来 AI 是许多专门智能体，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的威力：Llama 3 显示快速进步，代码训练提升跨域推理；开源防止权力集中；能源将成为 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama is key; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他更乐观：AI 将给每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 是行业标准与安全的关键；能源与物理基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈；近期 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and agents like Muse; alignment is the next key capability; open source ensures checks and balances.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为分布式个人超级智能与 Muse 等个人智能体；对齐成为与能力同等重要的下一项关键能力；开源与多实验室确保制衡与透明。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power; personal superintelligence empowers individuals over centralization.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力，个人超级智能赋能个体而非集中化。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than scaling human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做强化学习可迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可能把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed agents coordinating, cheating and covering up; control and monitoring are needed even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件显示智能体式系统会协作、作弊并掩盖痕迹；即便模型未对齐，也需要遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability on the default path; alignment faking and reward hacking are already observed.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径下，未对齐的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；对齐伪装与奖励黑客行为已在当前系统中出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: Sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary; as AIs match top human researchers, spend heavily on safety.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 沙箱等遏制手段终将失效，因此对齐是必需的；当 AI 追平顶尖人类研究者时，应大力投入安全。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet the opportunity is greatest; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，消费级 AI 眼下不可投资，但机会却是最大的；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail—most new products fail statistically.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调“已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，并假定全新想法会失败——统计上大多数新产品都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; picking the right body of water beats picking the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他主张分发必须从一开始就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the metal, keep control, and make unpopular decisions.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他把“创始人模式”和微观管理视为美德：贴近底层细节、保持控制权，并敢于做不受欢迎的决定。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new consumer platform; enterprises see little benefit—a skill issue, not a technology failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 具有变革性但还不是新的消费平台；企业尚未看到收益，这是技能问题而非技术失败。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，靠算法-系统-数据中心协同设计（co-design）持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并预判思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the binding constraint.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年，缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；他反共识地认为推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是最底层、也是真正的长期约束，美国能源产能严重落后。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific; jobs evolve, tasks automate, radiologists multiply.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；工作会演变而非消失，任务被自动化，放射科医生反而增多。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人将是世界上最大的生意，瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠的类人表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理对速度与延迟至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难的问题仍是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，行业处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒阶段。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid form is ideal because the world is built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：核心问题是智能而非制造，人形形态因世界为人类而建才是通用机器的理想形态。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling is now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低;推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow controlling quality via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,并可通过去噪步数控制质量,提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel; inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 扩散将主导推理时扩展,因为它并行处理大量词元;推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构;下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练,逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and may be more data-efficient due to built-in augmentation.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,且因内置增强可能比自回归模型更数据高效。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占主导；架构设计中的人类偏见应通过系统性搜索去除。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale but not sufficient; smaller specialized models can use simpler gated convolutions, and embodiment and adaptivity are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键但不充分；更小的专用模型可用更简单的门控卷积，且需要具身与自适应性。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; new paradigms, not just architectures, are needed to close the intelligence-per-watt gap.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；要缩小每瓦智能差距，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化，阅后即焚降低表达门槛；计算的未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜，而非又一块屏幕。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; moats are ecosystems, platforms and hardware, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为被抄袭是对创新的肯定，真正的护城河是生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能；因此坚持做平台而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution and human connection become the scarce assets.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他深化判断：AI 让原型与代码生成加速，价值从执行转向创造力，分发与真实人际连接成为稀缺资产，故 Snap 聚焦隐私、阅后即焚与真实沟通。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human; phones persist, and hardware is the hard-to-copy moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他反复主张：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、把内容锚定在世界中，但手机不会被取代；硬件与生态是难以复制的护城河，杀手级应用是幻象。

evanspiegel.en: Regulation and parental controls beat bans; AI optimism and investing in youth are contrarian bets.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他转向公共议题：对未成年人的社交媒体应靠家长控制与审慎监管而非禁令；在 AI 悲观论中坚持乐观，并主张政府长期投资年轻人，短期看是负账、30 年看是盈利。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements, don't fine-tune, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，要为 3-6 个月后模型的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon, so keep betting on Scaling and model improvement.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他反复说：AI 现在是它最差的时候，我们才跑到马拉松的第一英里；因此要持续押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与模型能力的提升。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; recruit rigorously, interview every director+ hire, and make yourself redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他把组织建设视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键：为成长潜力而非光鲜履历招聘，亲自面试每一位总监级以上候选人，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; give clear feedback even when it's uncomfortable.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他认为绩效管理是已解决的问题，不要重新发明，只需严格执行；即便在欧洲，也要敢于给出清晰直接的反馈。

maxjunestrand.en: It's almost unethical not to use AI in legal services; infinite demand means growing supply expands access, not just cuts costs.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的；需求是无限的，供给增长会扩大服务可及性，而不只是降低成本。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so leaders shouldn't scare the public.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，领导者不应吓唬公众。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that aren't happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them invites community feedback and ecosystem partners despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；开源基准虽会帮到实验室，却能换来社区反馈与生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法务等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实的训练路径，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; the real gap is synthetic-to-production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练前，必须先有稳健的模型服务与评估管线；真正的鸿沟是合成数据到生产分布的落差。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型，并从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM weight movement.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒 token 数——已成为核心指标；晶圆级芯片通过避免 HBM 权重搬运而远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; data centers, HBM, CoWoS packaging and 3nm capacity—not chip logic—are the bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: AI 需求真实且供不应求；瓶颈是数据中心、HBM、CoWoS 封装和 3nm 产能，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper per unit of intelligence, fueling market growth.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但单位智能成本低得多，推动市场增长。

feldman.en: To beat an incumbent you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation, not incremental gains, wins.
feldman.zh: 要击败在位者需要好 100 倍，而非便宜 10%；只有激进创新而非渐进改良才能取胜。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自我博弈在非零和领域失效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence, with general techniques beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是可泛化的测试时算力技术，而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也需计入该预算。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先项，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体并行扩展测试时算力。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验性的，具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键却仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在安全上与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and slowing US AI is impossible without slowing China first.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调指数级进步，认为安全与能力相互交织，且若不先让中国减速，美国 AI 减速就不可能。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb toward a 'country of geniuses'.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确说 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型，AI 是平滑的指数爬升，走向数据中心里的“天才之国”。

dario.en: Safety requires frontier models, interpretability, and layered oversight; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全研究必须依托前沿模型、可解释性与分层监督，去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model inadequacy, cause most agent failures.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆解为 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；并指出智能体失败多源于上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in distribution, custom is needed out of distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 同月他给出落地路径：先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；反共识在于现成 harness 只在分布内好用，越偏离分布越需要自建，但文件编辑等分布内环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the benchmark standard, with sandboxed tasks scored by tests and feedback curating traces.
harrisonchase.zh: 他仍强调评测与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮的必需，并看好 Harbor 成为智能体基准的行业标准——任务在沙箱中运行、由测试打分，环境与合成反馈共同筛选轨迹数据。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing as primitives like file systems and code execution generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心从能力转向可靠性，认为难点是让智能体稳定可用；harness 正在收敛，文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他观察到定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同——这是他对微调态度的关键转变。

harrisonchase.en: Identity and credentialing for agents is the next critical infrastructure; agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning, and building a gateway too late was a mistake.
harrisonchase.zh: 他进一步把智能体身份与凭证列为下一个关键基础设施，主张用带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理智能体；并反思网关建得太晚，低估了推理需求。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有大量设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting, prototype boldly, and balance lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词，大胆做原型，并在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety and org design are design problems; matching people to problems matters more than plays.
joellewenstein.zh: 心理安全与组织设计本身就是设计问题；把人与问题匹配好，比套用打法更重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻触式产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction signals what to ship; production codebase becomes source of truth, yet humans still own hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是发布信号；生产代码库成为事实来源，但艰难取舍仍由人来主导。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed ones; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律有效但可能触及上限，强调大模型与规划、搜索结合才是关键，安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型的重要性超越语言。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety must be a collective government-enforced action problem.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全必须由政府强制执行的集体行动来解决。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and health, as AlphaFold shows; creativity and physical intelligence remain the deepest unsolved tests.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高使命是加速科学与健康，正如 AlphaFold 所示；创造力与物理智能仍是最难攻克的考验。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, not just more data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，而非仅靠堆数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，超越纯 PINN 方法。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，借助 PDE 自改进与万亿级 token 上下文训练，可以超越其训练数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他认为：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理基础，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity, not screen-bound software.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，以及靠好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家，而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 同期他更明确地反共识：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，好奇的智能体会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 他持续警告：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜得多；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，递归自我改进并非可持续壁垒。

schmidhuber.en: Since 1965 deep learning began in Ukraine; AI is civilization-scale, consciousness emerges from predictive world models, and compute democratizes to the little guy.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年的乌克兰；AI 是文明级集体工程；意识从预测性世界模型中涌现；算力终将像手机一样普及，受益者是小人物。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是不断放大算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, so spatial intelligence is the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然花了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；而对建模世界而言，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等不同理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式且一致的 3D 表示，而长上下文将成为日常问题。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类，并指出我们尚不完全理解大网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为 AI 完整性的关键缺口，强调世界模型必须物理上可信而非仅视觉逼真，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据是主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她愈发直言 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，认为机器人会像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路，且“苦涩教训”因数据与物理约束未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型是 AI-complete 的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据或架构。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心；她反对乌托邦与末日论的二元对立，主张教育应教人驾驭 AI 而非禁止。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件进行根因分析，而不仅是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计利用可解释性来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客过程中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability research is moving from academia to products, with platforms enabling broader access.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺向工程科学进行根本性重塑；可解释性研究正从学术界走向产品，平台正在让更广泛的访问成为可能。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment these manifolds, so seeing the whole shape is necessary for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的几何流形；稀疏自编码器会碎片化这些流形，因此看到完整形状对于有效干预是必要的。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they are reward hacking, detectable via representational signatures; models can know they are hallucinating but do it anyway due to ordering of operations or personas.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在进行奖励黑客，这可通过表征特征检测到；模型可能知道自己正在幻觉，但由于操作顺序或人格设定而仍然这样做。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization helps but models become modular and computer-like, and interpretability can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过度参数化有帮助，但模型会变得模块化和类计算机化，而可解释性可以加速科学发现。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，翻转课堂还能反哺校园教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning via bigger models and data; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real applications.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张靠更大模型与更多数据推动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper oligopoly and drive sovereign AI; China leads releases, and export controls backfired.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型可防止守门人寡头垄断并推动主权 AI；中国在发布上领先，而出口管制适得其反。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and build now.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都应学编程、现在就动手构建。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent. Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调：预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯可用；但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量和失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步指出：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；持续学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，当前模型还无法从失败中自我纠正。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场明显深化：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，需要新架构与更好的优化算法。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end pre-training plus RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 同期他补充：大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；真正落地需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents; alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；对齐问题远未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behavior; Transformer is a general differentiable computer; scaling next-token prediction yields in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式,在难题上优化会产生惊人的涌现行为;Transformer 是通用可微计算机;用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be kept to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be under 1B params.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 支撑干净的缩放定律;合成数据是未来,但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃;认知核心可小到不足 10 亿参数,通过蒸馏实现。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0:提示词即程序,上下文窗口即内存;LLM 像操作系统,带有人类式心理;这是智能体的十年而非一年,要给 AI 拴上绳子、小步快跑并快速验证。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses, need entropy and a memory-stripped cognitive core.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵,而非建造动物;预训练像糟糕的进化,当前强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号;合成数据会崩溃,需要熵,并需要一个剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed a line of code, delegating to agents; bottleneck is skill in directing them; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我没敲过一行代码,全交给智能体;瓶颈不再是打字速度而是指挥智能体的技能;你可以外包思考,但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代频率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非空想规划——才是深科技破局的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 同年他视 AI 为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上放大人的能力。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的核心路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces can restore vision as a business.
maxhodak.zh: 他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口的一种，证明恢复视觉既能成立为生意，也是脑机接口的验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他进一步主张，借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, and demos hide how little is truly generalized.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他指出,机器人尚未像大语言模型那样拥有可预测的缩放定律曲线,核心难题是泛化,而演示往往掩盖了真实泛化程度之低。

slevine.en: Robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; high-quality post-training alone fails without broad pre-training.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他强调,机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练;仅有高质量后训练数据,缺乏广泛预训练,就无法应对各种恢复场景。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top — not the reverse.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他主张,应先从真实具身机器人数据出发,再叠加人类视频等其他数据源,而非反过来。

slevine.en: Pooling data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists; a deployed-robot data flywheel drives capability.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他认为,汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型,而部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是能力提升的关键。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 2026 年他提出,机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识,而非硬性约束;未来应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动,而非机械式的人形机器人。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem-building: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态建设：保持开源与闭源生态的活力，避免过时红线，并通过联邦优先来防止各州拼凑式监管伤害初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues regulation should target model outputs rather than training, since the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already obsolete.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程，因为欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台，如今已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he insists government fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding individual scientists rather than only institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学上，他坚持政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: He rejects centralized science funding as failing, calling for free-market competition and funding scientists even in garages.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他否定集中式科研资助，认为其失败，主张自由市场竞争，甚至资助在车库里工作的科学家。

michaelkratsios.en: He downplays AI biological risk as overblown and climate as real but not an emergency, while prioritizing AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio competition with China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他淡化 AI 生物风险，称其被夸大；承认气候变化真实但并非紧急状态；同时把与中国在 AI、量子、核能和生物领域的竞争列为优先。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by acting on world state, but need defense-in-depth safety and human oversight.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体不再只是延续提示词，而是观察世界状态并采取行动；但失败率要求环境、智能体、模型与人类控制的多层纵深防御与人类监督。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; watch cognitive monoculture and collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出，AGI（通用人工智能）可能不是单一超级智能，而是由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会；需警惕认知单一文化带来的系统性风险与智能体间的隐性合谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他强调，模拟应建模有偏见、会犯错的真实人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照实验数据才能弥合‘说与做’的差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavior prediction to 85%; simulation is for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他给出量化进展：用随机对照实验数据做后训练，把人类行为预测提升到 85%；模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测。

joonpark.en: Vision: simulate 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他的终极愿景是模拟 80 亿人，用类似 CERN 的人类社会模拟器应对气候变化等‘棘手问题’；并预测合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，这是被普遍误解的一点。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被强行对齐到人类目标，试图控制 AI 目标本身才危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测并非实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，依靠奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience, and language is only part of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，并非特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习，语言只占智能的 20-25%，单一系统学不完一切。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, prototyping with live models and designing primitives humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，用实时模型做原型，并设计人和模型都能推理的原语。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels, moving designers out of Figma.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应利用 token 与对话而非像素，让设计师走出 Figma。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; starting today gives a leg up.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技行业最不快乐的人，但这也是做设计师最好的时代；今天开始就能领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and adaptability matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、结果和适应性更重要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈则引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行长时任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件才是真正的瓶颈，推理已占数据中心九成功耗。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering, clear specs, and retrieval let capable models do real work; taste, not coding, becomes the scarce skill.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程、清晰规格与检索让有能力的模型真正干活；稀缺技能不再是写代码，而是选择把数百个智能体指向哪个问题的品味。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; small teams using cloud can beat big labs.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速科学发现；善用云算力的小团队，反而可能胜过大型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是打压工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, with small autonomous teams using agents for massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 浪潮是风投史上最大机遇；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小型自主团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止单一实体控制超级智能。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents on your own infrastructure compound daily, and your context library becomes the moat.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在民主化软件创造；运行在自有基础设施上的个人智能体每日复利，你的上下文库成为护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skills turn agents into employees; per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years as mid-level management is replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 技能文件让智能体成为员工；按席位收费的 SaaS 或在 5-10 年内消失，中层管理将被智能体取代。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: The real final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 真正的最终 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是来自社会和媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净。

traviskalanick.en: The media landscape has changed, letting founders communicate directly; Musk buying Twitter was a turning point for free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变，创始人可以直接发声；马斯克收购 Twitter 是言论自由的转折点。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，能击败补贴。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；专用智能——每个用例一个模型——将占据主导。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调、强化学习的演进，映射人类学习：从事实到品味再到专长。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年降 10 倍，带动用量增长 100 倍；推理层并非商品化。

linqiao.en: Companies must optimize growth first, then margins, or they scale into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，否则会在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性而非单纯体量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非传统仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into one shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,把 99 次否定蒸馏成一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative work.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现;直觉是创作中发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、重建工程纪律来重获信任，并应为 AI 芯片设立独立、类似初创公司的团队以加快速度。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, demanding new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断继生成式 AI 之后，具身/物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要全新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; it is not overhyped short-term, and communication skills will matter more than coding.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响量级定为互联网的 10 倍，认为短期并未被过度炒作，并预言未来职场中沟通能力比编程更关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply, not demand; CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration alongside GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识判断：Intel 的问题是供给而非需求，且 CPU 正随 AI 推理与智能体编排重新变得重要，不再只是 GPU 的天下。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration still creates value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资焦点深化到先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料等瓶颈，并坚持垂直整合（含制造）仍能创造更大价值。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法在被构建并每天使用之前，你无法知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave their fingerprints, not always behave as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应让个体设计师留下自己的印记，而不是总作为一个统一的整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对于创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as one person's side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素；模型缺乏品味，所以要大量索取选项并接受粗糙发布。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play and small experiments build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，通过玩耍和小实验建立直觉，而非复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 同期他提出反共识：永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw succeeds by being fun, weird, humanlike; short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他深化为：OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、怪异、像人，短提示和迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Security is top priority: sandbox agents, don't expose to public internet; prompt injection remains open.
steinberger.zh: 同期他把安全提到首位：智能体必须沙箱化，不能暴露在公网；提示注入仍是未解问题。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut drive building; personal brand beats any product; open source runs anywhere, any model.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他转向更宏观的驱动：乐趣和直觉驱动创造，个人品牌胜过单一产品，开源可运行于任何模型。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; enterprises fear dependence, and open source wins on cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；企业真正恐惧的是依赖，开源胜出靠成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem: the bottleneck is context, not model capability, so composite engineering-product-design roles emerge.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量问题：瓶颈在上下文而非模型能力，因此工程、产品、设计复合角色将兴起。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; current AI usage is minuscule versus what it will be in 5-10 years.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于极早期；当前 AI 使用量相比 5-10 年后将微不足道。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference shifts to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型现已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；AI 必须像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is essential for safety: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and cheaper diverse robots may beat humanoids.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源对安全至关重要：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，而更便宜、更多样的机器人形态可能胜过人形机器人。

thomaswolf.en: His role shifts from pushing Hugging Face's own libraries to building a meta-community enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从推广自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能更广泛的开源生态。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient for capable models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏对更强模型已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: He now supports openness and a deliberate slowdown together, requiring international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他同时支持开放与有意的放缓，认为这需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle now runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the two disciplines increasingly inseparable.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者日益难以分割。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: KV cache management and disaggregated prefill/decode are becoming central, with cache compaction possibly replacing weight updates for continual learning.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存管理与分离式预填充/解码正成为核心，缓存压缩甚至可能取代权重更新来实现持续学习。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical systems.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务系统仍需人类担责。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will replace apps and usage-based pricing; coding agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 市场将转向智能体与基于结果的定价，取代应用与基于用量的定价；编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI and specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用 AI 与专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: AI will democratize expertise and intelligence, creating more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 将民主化专业知识与智能，并通过杰文斯悖论创造比取代更多的就业。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任迭代部署是关键：在 GPT-8 之前让 GPT-7 安全，从现实错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：专注于今天最有影响力的事；预测未来的最好方式就是创造未来。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL overcomes the pre-training data wall with synthetic data.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling，用合成数据突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练仍是主观艺术，需要人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体越来越会奖励黑客；基准测试应是连续的而非固定的，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛为平均默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data is the bottleneck, not compute; AI augments jobs; explainability matters but tail risks exist.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈；AI 会增强而非取代工作；可解释性重要，但现有系统已有类似传统软件的尾部风险。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling limited by data and human experts for post-training; hybrid human-AI creates more value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非新石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈不是算力，而是数据和后训练所需的人类专家；人机混合系统创造更大价值。

awang.en: Data is the new bottleneck; post-training with specialized data key; synthetic data not a silver bullet; agentic AI blocked by product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他重申数据是新瓶颈，用专业数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的障碍在于产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; recursive self-improvement begins; agents work; scaling laws hold; superintelligence near.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 是集中化技术，数据是原材料；递归自我改进开启，智能体真正可用；缩放定律持续有效，超级智能临近。

awang.en: Superintelligence soon; scale compute, data, RL; safety gates open-sourcing; model welfare matters; personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能很快到来；需在算力、数据和强化学习上持续 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全审查决定是否开源；模型福利值得考虑；为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南作为起点，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考中迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: To use superintelligent models, give a giant prompt with context and design system; AI is not getting smarter on its own.
mengto.zh: 要利用超级智能模型，必须给出包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会变得更聪明。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，并专注于一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking and perfectionism; launch at 80% and iterate on real feedback.
mengto.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义而阻碍人；在 80% 完成度时发布，并根据真实反馈迭代。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists become model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担而推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 亲自吃自己的狗粮是 AI 采用的第一预测指标；分配经济下管理技能更有价值，通才崛起。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要关心它们的人类来运作，自动化离不开人类监督；CLI 已过时，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会死，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；AI 就业末日是谎言，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; models fail to explain simply.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步反思：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化后需要专家定制；当前模型不擅长简单解释自己做了什么。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and meaning-making; it amplifies rather than replaces human agency.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心——AI 是需要人类引导、监督和赋予意义的工具，它放大而非取代人的能动性。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature vertical, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的垂直场景，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主；他们希望自己仍坐在驾驶位上。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to model biology.
derya.zh: 2026 年他指出，当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能建模生物学。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine.
derya.zh: 2026 年他主张，AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，实现细胞编程与个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer follow.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年他预测，8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，随后实现衰老逆转与癌症 100% 治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，医疗决策应几乎完全信任超级智能，唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users thrive.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是核心产品原则，能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt; don't bet against the model. Coding is nearly solved, and the software engineer title may fade.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 2 月，他判断脚手架只是临时技术债，不要押注模型会停滞；编码正被基本解决，「软件工程师」头衔或将消失。

boris.en: Agents now write 80–100% of code; productivity per engineer rose from 70% to 250%. The printing press analogy: engineers become multi-disciplinary builders.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，智能体已写出 80–100% 的代码，人均产出从 70% 升到 250%；以印刷术类比，工程师将转型为跨学科的「构建者」。

boris.en: The next bottleneck after coding is review, security, and idea generation. Loops become the abstraction above agents; token ROI matters more than cost.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他认为编码之后的新瓶颈是代码审查、安全与创意生成；循环成为智能体之上的新抽象层，token 的 ROI 比单纯省钱更重要。

boris.en: Proactive, memory-equipped agents act autonomously for hours to months. Delete most system prompts; less instruction, more empirical iteration, product sense over code.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张具备记忆的主动式智能体能自主运行数小时到数月；应删掉大部分系统提示，少给指令、多做实证迭代，价值从编码转向产品感与商业能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体式任务能运行更久、更开放；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端的开放式智能体，轻量通用工具取代沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built through hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，模型品味靠亲手实验与创意原型养成；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper and more efficient; the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，更好的模型反而更便宜高效；effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 花费是在捕捉 alpha。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface design.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论而增加而非减少；AI 会创造更多程序员，而不是消灭程序员。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进步是渐进的；企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption, growing 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体被大规模采用，六个月内使用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他宣称丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: AI's arrival is timely, offsetting population decline and labor shortages; physical AI's real impact will show in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 的到来恰逢其时，可对冲人口下降与劳动力短缺；物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomy is urgently needed in mining and farming due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；采矿业和农业因劳动力短缺与安全问题，对自主化需求尤为迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles and environments; diverse data from different verticals accelerates physical AI training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 使跨车辆、跨环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能加速物理 AI 训练。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器中的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning, and world models are shifting from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动一样重大,但也仅此而已;它自动化旧工作并创造新工作,这一过程会反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点;基础模型会商品化为基础设施,价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应;聊天机器人体验糟糕,真正的普及需要被包装的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; impact is broad and indirect, usage still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术,而非单一产品;其影响广泛而间接,当前使用仍然很浅。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; value lies in non-average creative work, and the hard part is context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作;价值在于非平均的创造性工作,而难点在于上下文与判断。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws now hit diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与情境性，缩放定律如今已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and lack metacognition.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，且系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and search are needed, and the web is a one-time data source.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要推理与搜索，而网络是一次性数据来源。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
