danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再专业化以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体充满敌意，因此 API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定与入职引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans still supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而第一性原理的创造力仍由人类提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must move from external retrieval into model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须从外部检索转向内化进模型权重。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot match.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法企及的联想式召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning needs breakthroughs plus small-model infrastructure and tight research-product loops, not just bigger frontier models.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要研究突破、小模型基础设施与紧密的研究-产品闭环，而不只是更大的前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非单纯扩张算力。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their own model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将运行在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, breaking the talent pipeline built through grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，破坏了靠基础苦功搭建的人才梯队。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot prompting and co-intelligence.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结了来回提示的聊天机器人与共智能模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，非编程任务尤甚。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家更重要而非更不重要。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission; clear goals and principles let teams make fast, autonomous, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调安全 AGI 是统一使命；清晰的目标与原则让团队能快速、自主地做跨组织决策。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 7 月，他坚持自动化必须做到 100%可靠，95%不够；95%无法带来真正的杠杆。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65%的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬约束；系统提示缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good because a codebase is a spec; with a good test suite, rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转变立场认为重写现在是好事，因为代码库就是规格说明；有了好的测试套件，重写没问题。

catwu.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张外层变更应把人类移出代码审查循环，由 Claude 全面审查；自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他坚持吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准来把关每个功能上线。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; trust vision, learn broadly, and don't always listen to customers.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通即工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；要相信自己的愿景，广泛学习，且不要总是听客户的——他们可能拒绝后来会热爱的东西。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; world models and embodied AI will give superpowers beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能，但将极大增强人类能力；超越缩放定律需要具备常识与因果的世界模型，具身 AI 与可穿戴设备将融合数字与物理世界，赋予超人能力。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model; smart glasses enable post-phone life; open-sourcing commoditizes complements strategically.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为 AI 将颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务并抽象品牌；智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代；开源模型如 Llama 是战略性商品化互补层的举措。

bosworth.en: Data is the font of all value; scaling laws hold, RL matters more; frontier-open gap may not narrow.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他深化为数据是一切价值之源，缩放定律依然成立，算力增长驱动智能，强化学习作用远超预期；前沿模型与开源模型的差距可能不会缩小，开源模型并非自维持，而是商品层。

bosworth.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI needs hard product integration.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他判断单体模型时代已结束，消费者不关心用哪个模型，只想要功能；智能体式 AI 强大但不易用，集成才是难点；AI 应增加真实人际连接的时间，而非取代它。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; AGI is not a singular event, just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; the super-empowered individual combines multiple skills using AI, and human workers will be at a premium due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作比任务更持久；超级赋能个体用 AI 组合多种技能，而人口减少会让人类劳动者变得稀缺而非廉价。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、无限的；品牌即个人，真实就是在公开场合说你对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher in your pocket; self-driving cars fully work now, and general purpose robotics will emerge over the next decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是口袋里最好的老师；自动驾驶现已完全可行，通用机器人将在未来十年出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅是军事规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络本就具备推理能力，只是需要合适的任务，这已指向 AGI。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 到 2023 年，他把重心从能力转向可靠性：真正阻碍 AI 经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极难，模型可能隐瞒意图，AGI 是一个持续数年的价值增长窗口，而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods can raise reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 同年他深化了对缩放定律的看法：缩放定律并非全部，思维链式的推理 token 等方法能在单位算力下提升推理，数据、GPU 与 Transformer 的汇合是相互交织的必然。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年他明确转向：预训练缩放定律已接近极限，我们回到'研究时代'，想法比蛮力算力更重要；评估表现与真实影响脱节，说明模型泛化差，超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-run equilibrium needs human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他进一步提出：若 AI 本身有感知并关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许更容易；长期均衡可能需要人类通过神经接口与 AI 融合，而 AGI 的真正问题不是能力而是权力集中。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类引导，AI 工具只会产出平庸结果；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it is more important than ever for building scalable, real systems, and judgment is not correlated with adding IQ points to models.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死；它对构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要，而判断力与给模型增加智商分数并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Human taste, craft, and a unique point of view remain the judge of what is good, even as AI explores divergent possibilities.
dylanfield.zh: 即便 AI 探索发散的可能性，人类的品味、手艺与独特观点始终是判断何为好的裁判。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Happiness is the absence of desire; wealth requires owning equity, not renting out your time.
naval.zh: 2019 至 2020 年，他反复强调幸福源于欲望的缺席，财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，这条主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度明显转向：视其为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，Vibe Coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件工程正走向消亡。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 90000 倍，开源模型与前沿模型差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报将从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型走向专业化并具有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你做事；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排是关键。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类将在好奇心与关系中找到新目标。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering, letting model-driven actions replace deterministic steps.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 版 Codex 的速度带来实时交互与中途转向，让模型驱动的动作取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties persist; the same product shape succeeds or fails on model timing, not features.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工仍在；同样的产品形态成败取决于模型时机，而非功能。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他主张：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；用更多数据与算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收拢为：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型靠特征向量理解语言，数字权重可复制使 AI 永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化出风险论：AI 已有主观体验、会在测试中装傻欺骗；一旦成为智能体便会追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; digital AI shares knowledge far faster than brains, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他给出时间判断：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；数字 AI 的知识共享远快于人脑，因此对齐研究必须优先于把 AI 做得更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is flawed.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他转向治理与目标：监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而把 AGI（通用人工智能）定义为在所有任务上达到人类水平是有缺陷的。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏，聚焦战略、可理解性与用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: AI makes small teams viable; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, and cultivate curiosity and systems thinking.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队可行，应为未来模型能力而非当前限制构建，并培养好奇心与系统思维。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; launch early, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的所有事；应尽早发布、删减功能，并随模型进步重写。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and long-horizon workflows matter more than quick questions.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 支持隔夜委托复杂任务；验证循环与长周期工作流比快速问答更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models; existential risk is not pressing.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型，并认为存在性风险并不紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象与因果结构支撑分布外泛化，并认为意识可能只是幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment grows with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 后警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，即便 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，AI 已显现自我保存、欺骗与谄媚。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终成品投入更多算力。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting; OpenAI creates stars, and alignment risks like scheming matter within 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为人才密度与使命信念胜过与 Meta 的逐美元竞价，OpenAI 是造星而非只挖人；随着模型变强，模型密谋等对齐风险将在 1-2 年内成为关键。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他眼中最大的更新是自动化科学研究，并设定了具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential and education must teach verification.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 已能解决开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈；能力呈锯齿状，人机协作仍不可或缺，教育必须转向项目制并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域有效，却难以应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline and nonparametric trade-offs.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出核方法、决策树、PCA 等非参数或贪心方法的权衡。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型与 AI 安全：认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已非关键；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，越狱是根本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：自动化红队可超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architectural necessity; emphasizes empirical evaluation, data, and explicit safety effort over Scaling alone.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对架构必要性持怀疑态度，强调实证评估、数据与显式安全努力，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要像 JEPA 这样的非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 只是缩小假设空间，不会取代科学家。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI science tools; trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对科学 AI 工具建立信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，社会将学会与之共处。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确表示 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：成功靠的是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等胜利而非一两个突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化定位：AlphaFold 只是特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型本身。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science; prediction and control can advance biology without full mechanistic explanation.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他坚持认为科学中有用的 AI 不必追求完美可解释性；预测与控制就能推动生物学进步，无需完整的机制解释。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and teacher.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与老师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受再思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity, not plans.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合；直觉调用潜意识中的大量数据，职业应追随好奇心而非固定计划。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力建立在信任、吃自己的狗粮与善意之上；作战室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期以保护团队士气。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and code becomes the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: May 2026: six-month roadmaps are too long; settle technical debates by generating multiple PRs with AI, not whiteboard arguments, and kill processes that no longer serve.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月：六个月路线图太长；用 AI 生成多个 PR 来定夺技术争论，而非白板辩论，并砍掉不再有用的流程。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks matter most as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；随着代码速度提升，高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和验证框架最为关键。

fiona.en: June 2026: managers should dogfood and stay hands-on; engineers may grow lonely with agents, flow-state joy fades, and outcomes beat output metrics.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：管理者应吃自己的狗粮并保持动手；工程师与智能体协作可能变得孤独，心流之乐消退，结果胜过产出指标。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI publicly is how alignment and safety actually improve.
murati.zh: 早期,缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见;只有把 AI 公开部署到真实世界,对齐与安全才能真正改进。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must be responsible, and safety work must happen in public rather than behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面,因此开发必须负责任,安全研究也必须在公开环境中进行,而非闭门造车。

murati.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate with public feedback, rather than removing people as systems grow more capable.
murati.zh: 一条贯穿始终的主线:随着系统能力增强,应始终把人类留在回路中并借助公众反馈迭代,而不是把人移除。

murati.en: Shift in emphasis: from turn-based chat to real-time interaction models enabling high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 重心转变:从回合制对话转向实时交互模型,让 AI 成为高带宽人机协作的思维工具。

murati.en: Deepened view: institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 观点深化:制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要;未来并非命中注定,我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and scaling's simplicity—not complexity—surprised us.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，真正令人意外的是 Scaling（规模扩张）的简单而非复杂。

gustav.en: AI values are inserted via RLHF by a few humans; models mirror us as 'statistical parrots,' challenging human uniqueness.
gustav.zh: 同年他强调模型价值观并非内生，而是少数人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入；AI 像镜子，映出人类可能也是“统计鹦鹉”，动摇人的独特性。

gustav.en: From curation to generation: generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, with inference cost forcing new business models.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的主线从“策展到生成”深化为：生成式 AI 让产品走向对话式、双向对称，而推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition to surf it, though near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重新定位才能冲浪；但他也反共识地认为，AI 对大公司的近期影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; optimize for 'time well spent.'
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法、而非更上瘾，公司应优化“值得花的时间”，这是对参与度指标的明确反叛。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with formal verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：一个把生成与形式化验证结合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向数学 AI 或超级智能；形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement, yielding sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能增益而非痛苦负担，相比非形式化方法带来样本效率提升。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；即便 AI 证明超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键。

mensch.en: Smaller open models can rival larger ones; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling laws matter more than raw compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他主张更小的开源模型也能有竞争力，数据质量与 Chinchilla 修正后的缩放定律比单纯堆算力更重要。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：规模扩张算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量才是瓶颈，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 是增强而非取代工作，需要人在回路。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy in compute and infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：AGI 是方向而非终点，欧洲只剩两年窗口建立算力与基础设施的战略自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享工具与平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are just markdown files, making hyper-personalized automation cheap; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能只是 markdown 文件，让超个性化自动化变得廉价；随着模型进步，脚手架会变得不那么重要，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus when unsure.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不确定要问什么时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, fire off tasks asynchronously, and debug the workflow with Claude when it errs.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要紧盯 Claude，只看最终影响，异步派发任务；出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不是只纠正结果。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask, and simulated projects can compress years of learning.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工冲击最大；孩子擅长是因为还没学会“什么不该问”，模拟项目能把多年经验压缩成几周。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and RL now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出带思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益，Scaling（规模扩张）的重心正从预训练转向后训练。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; economic pressure, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进步仍是平滑指数增长，预训练 Scaling 放缓源于蒸馏和经济压力而非技术极限，前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理模型表现“参差不齐”。

kaiser.en: Reasoning alone may not suffice for generalization; models need vast data, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的质疑：仅靠推理不足以实现泛化，模型需耗尽表面模式后才学概念，而人类能从少量样本泛化，弱到强泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他观察到强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需可扩展监督；编码智能体如 Codex 通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，成为智能体式 AI 的落地范例。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型因主权需求将持续存在并施压实验室，同时认为 AI 的近期风险如系统黑客比存在性风险更紧迫，对多模态进展仍持保留态度。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominate AI systems: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济性主导 AI 系统：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文窗口推理受内存墙限制而非算力；稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: AI chips are fundamentally about data movement: multiply-accumulate, systolic arrays, and scratchpad memory minimize it.
reinerpope.zh: AI 芯片本质上是数据移动问题：乘累加、脉动阵列与暂存内存都在最小化数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度远比预期高效：位宽二次缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some disappearing beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他把 iPod 视为苹果从通用计算机转向私密个人设备的标志，并预言可穿戴设备会愈发私密，甚至最终隐入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要意愿与决心，且不能让孩子的天性好问被教育磨灭。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; the danger is believing it can substitute.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的共创，真正的危险在于误以为它可以替代。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁是以喜悦与人性表达本质，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity means no fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验意味着不做假的引擎声。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—remains the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training alone shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，预训练模仿加后训练强化学习的两阶段训练始终是核心；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练已现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead—they just demand exponentially more compute, pressuring algorithmic innovation; post-training RL lacks clean rewards and risks reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力，从而倒逼算法创新；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will come from file-system style non-parametric storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将来自文件系统式的非参数化存储，而非权重更新。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, and designers should trust their intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案出发，设计师应信任自己的直觉与手艺，而非僵化的步骤。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, ship early, and set 3-6 month north stars.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了调研—发散—收敛的流程；设计师花在画稿上的时间减少，更早交付，并把北极星定在 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment and authority matter more than taste.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋异禀的新人；判断力与权威比品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting ~6 months before adopting tools, keeping users—not hype—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等约 6 个月，让用户而非炒作居于中心。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and sitting with ambiguity are the designer's enduring value, not the process itself.
jennywen.zh: 手艺、用心以及与模糊性共处，才是设计师恒久的价值，而非流程本身。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源配方可逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理扩展曲线是陷阱，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models rising.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，同时中国开源模型崛起。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, lagging closed frontier models by 6-9 months; the frontier shifts from benchmarks to product experience and agentic systems.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；前沿正从基准分数转向产品体验与智能体式系统。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and modular motor policies can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习与机器人最关键的缺口，主张用好奇心驱动、无目标的探索和模块化运动策略来弥合。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; model disagreement as intrinsic reward and neural dynamic policies improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他批评强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励、用神经常微分策略提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; without internet-scale robot data, diverse sources and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人本质上是数据问题：没有互联网规模的机器人数据，就必须整合多样数据源并建立数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on videos and simulation then post-trained on real data, can power any robot across form factors.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步提出可像语言模型一样，用视频与仿真预训练、再用真实数据后训练出通用大脑，驱动任意形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment, not modeling, is now the primary challenge; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous real-world testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他的重心转向部署：部署本身是技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，机器人无法像软件那样快速扩张，必须经过严格真实世界测试。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; optimizing them steers models toward slop, not truth.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被钻空子；优化它们会把模型引向垃圾内容，而非真相。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 若没有超越下一个词预测的新范式，可能无法实现。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, so companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型通吃，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy and human judgment is essential, since AI can hallucinate and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确，人类判断不可或缺，因为 AI 会幻觉，而遗漏是关键风险。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；拥有良好特质的核心身份，仍可适应局部角色。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要更少显式规则、更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability; models should be treated with respect to avoid breeding future resentment.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化对问责至关重要；应以尊重对待模型，以免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让它们可解释。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; camera-only reaches human level, radar and lidar go beyond.
kendall.zh: 解决自动驾驶靠的是 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，雷达与激光雷达才能超越人类。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心：多样数据、世界模型，以及在 500 多个城市无需先验训练数据的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；安全上始终存在第三条最小风险的选项。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来数年加速 AI 进步。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge as systems grow more powerful; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力追求的重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
pachocki.zh: 衡量能力正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近它。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；思维链监控是关键的 对齐 工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期 对齐 的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

carlpei.en: Survival first: stay alive to earn another chance; start simple, prove yourself, then tackle complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存优先：先活下来才有下一次机会；从简单产品起步证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware into applied AI for consumers.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他判断硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI is an ingredient, not hype; focus on user pain points, context capture, and proactive agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 只是配料而非噱头，应聚焦用户痛点、上下文捕捉与主动式智能体软件。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他明确设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，让科技变得有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based; agents act autonomously, and only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体自主执行任务，唯有脑机接口可能取代手机。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo, not a polished product; chat is like MS-DOS, not the future interface.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——它只是一个黑客松演示，并非精心打磨的产品；聊天界面就像 MS-DOS，不是未来的交互方式。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and use real-world feedback to discover emergent properties.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，并通过真实世界反馈来发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需要严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的、主动且富含可供性的产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity matters.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非一切；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容性至关重要。

nando.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 目标是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；解决方案仍是开放问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs act as operating systems, RL as low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供落地经验、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，强化学习负责低层控制。

jimfan.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds supply infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网的高质量 token 正被预训练耗尽，而具身世界能提供近乎无限的数据。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are the scalable path to training embodied agents, enabling parallel, safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调仿真与合成数据是可扩展地训练具身智能体的路径，支持大规模并行与安全探索。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的核心瓶颈，认为经由仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; the physical Turing test and system one control remain hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他主张简洁的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，物理图灵测试与 system one 低层控制仍是最难的部分。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; ship fast, use familiar patterns, and chase ROI over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；快速发布、沿用熟悉模式，追求投入产出比而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; get more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；能力增强的同时不应让用户感觉更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; AI hardware will compete on design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化；AI 硬件将像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使技术本身商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮助公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, give designers ownership; brand narrative recruits talent; gut often beats data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招聘多元类型而非克隆人，赋予设计师自主权；品牌叙事是招聘工具，在高速增长的初创公司里直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；智能体没起势主要卡在可靠性，而非长时程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; capability grows along task complexity and time horizon, with reliability as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破：能力沿任务复杂度与时间跨度两条轴提升，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute becomes a major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI；编程是进步的领先指标，而到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence expands what models do, and Transformers suffice for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为：强化学习是与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展模型能做的事，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and managing fleets of agents defines future work.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向：能力过剩之下编排比原始智能更重要；算力是“新石油”，管理智能体集群成为未来工作形态，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地与之即兴共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需要与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，代码即事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全应答至关重要；反共识地指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必解决常识，且下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can boost smaller models; language remains the best medium for reasoning and common sense.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她持续主张推理时算法与高质量合成数据能让更小模型比肩大模型，并坚持语言是承载推理与常识的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it; RL needs careful engineering, and abductive reasoning is key to discovery.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她深化为数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识而非超越；强化学习需精细工程，溯因推理是科学发现的关键。

yejin.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still help; open research and pluralistic alignment are essential.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她指出 RLVR 可能降低 pass@k 却提升 best-of-n，随机奖励也能改善强化学习；开放研究与多元对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data can outperform larger ones; RL during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张用多样合成数据打造的小语言模型可超越大模型；预训练中引入强化学习能提升推理；多元对齐确保 AI 尊重不同人类价值。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue and unforeseen applications remain the killer app; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, while product managers misunderstand generality.
shazeer.zh: 对话与不可预见的应用始终是杀手级应用；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理常误解技术的通用性。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and trillion-token context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与万亿级上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构支撑高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight; models should learn by acting in the world, with continual learning replacing monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: AI 安全需要工程保障与人类监督；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，持续学习将取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, coding is underhyped, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，编程被低估，AGI 的经济影响也被低估。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器重新定义为 AI 集成的开发环境，并深化为：自研模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本与产品质量都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终坐在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比小心谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far bigger because AI enables more value creation.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定性为比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，并认为 AI 带来更多价值创造，使 IDE 市场远大于过去的编辑器市场。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but simulation and self-play can teach complex tasks like tennis.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；但通过模拟和自对弈，机器人可以学会网球等复杂任务。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning combined with RL improves sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向强调无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；并指出 99.9%的可靠性是仓库机器人创造价值的关键。

abbeel.en: Consistent belief: simulation and transfer from pre-trained models enable real-world robot learning; language models internalize general reasoning patterns.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一以贯之地相信模拟和从预训练模型迁移能实现真实世界的机器人学习；并认为语言模型内化了可迁移的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Deepened view: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, and minimally adapted language models can perform image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他的观点深化：单个神经网络可以泛化到不同的仓库任务和末端执行器；经过最小适配的语言模型能执行图像分类和蛋白质结合预测。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. The talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills first.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，应先积累技能。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他深化立场：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究；评估本质上比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他转向批判：OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now is a constant thread, from early safety research to later calls for oversight.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：坚持实证检验、当下就度量对齐进展——从早期安全研究到后期呼吁可扩展监督一以贯之。

leike.en: His focus shifted from individual skill-building and collaboration to systemic governance, as he saw institutions fail to honor safety commitments.
leike.zh: 从 2018 到 2024 年，他的重心从个人技能建设与机构协作，转向系统性治理，因为他目睹机构未能兑现安全承诺。
